protocol.method: Per-stage physical barline identity/geometry and removal call paths; first isolate stage loss, then one evidence-supported safeguard; unchanged gates
protocol.heldOutPolicy: No held-out evaluation in this experiment
protocol.limitations: Repeated training probe already diagnosed by the prior audit; candidate XML labels not independently certified; source-head observations single AI review; head-stage false-positive rate not fully annotated
protocol.sourcePolicy: Original scans, baseline source/build, original outputs and issued evidence immutable. No uploads, paid compute, model training or promotion.

design.evidence: All five training scans have identical physical bars through STEMS; first loss at REDUCTION; guard-off conflict logs show physical barlines defeated by overlapping stems. Final graph joins link many surviving competitor stems exclusively to logical fa heads, not proof of original support. New conflict logs record support at decision time.
design.intervention: In a direct exclusion, prefer a physical barline over a stem with nonempty all-fa HeadStemRelation support; otherwise preserve upstream grade ordering. No column rule, template, fill, anchor, or scoring changes.
